newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada trade minister collapses after speeches.
newsitem.headline: Canada trade minister collapses after speeches.

text.p: Canada's International Trade Mininster, Art Eggleton, was carried out of a conference on a stretcher Tuesday after he tripped and collapsed.
A series of speakers had just finished addressing a crowd at Toronto's Westin Harbour Castle Hotel when Eggleton tripped as he got up to leave the dignitaries' head table.

The other dignitaries helped a pale and shaky Eggleton to a chair where he waited with his head resting on a table until ambulance attendants arrived. The attendants strapped on an oxygen mask and carried Eggleton out on a stretcher.
Witnesses said he twisted his ankle as he fell and landed on his knee.
No further information about his condition was immediately available.
Eggleton had been speaking with Chilean President Eduardo Frei at a luncheon.
Canada and Chile signed a free trade pact in Ottawa on Monday.
